title: Chapter 10 — Business Costs and Production
desc: Explicit and implicit costs, accounting vs economic profit, diminishing marginal product, the family of cost curves, why MC crosses ATC at its minimum, and economies of scale.
intro: Economic profit counts the owner's opportunity costs as well as the bills. One fixed oven then explains the shape of every cost curve on the exam.
stats: 4 chunks · 2 live models · 4 checkpoints · 10-question practice exam
